jobs.occupation: Karstensens Skibsværft søger VVS'ere til Nybygningsafdeling
jobs.description:
(English below)

 

Karstensens Skibsværft søger VVS’ere til nybygningsafdelingen – vær med til at bygge fremtidens skibe

Er du VVS’er og klar på at prøve noget lidt anderledes – og ret sejt? Hos os får du chancen for at arbejde med VVS-installationer på helt nye skibe, hvor både teknik, teamwork og håndværk spiller en vigtig rolle.

Her hos Karstensens Skibsværft har vi lige nu 20 skibe i ordrebogen til levering over de næste 2 år. Derfor søger vi nu dygtige VVS’ere til at styrke vores nybygningsafdeling. Vores nybygninger er kendetegnet ved høj kvalitet og en høj grad af kundetilpassede løsninger, som skabes gennem engagement og tværfagligt samarbejde mellem rederi og medarbejdere.

 

Dine opgaver:

I stillingen er der afvekslende opgaver og projekter, hvor du kommer ud på mange forskellige nybygningsskibe – men generelt er der opgaver indenfor:

• Installation og opstart af vandbåren centralvarme

• Installation og opstart af vakuum og toilet systemer

• Installation og opstart af koldt og varmt vands anlæg

 

Vi forestiller os, at du:

• Er uddannet VVS’er eller rørlægger – eller lignende

• Du har lyst til at blive en del af en dynamisk og velfungerende arbejdsplads

• Du har lyst til at arbejde indenfor den maritime branche

• Du er pligtopfyldende, loyal, fleksibel og imødekommende

 

Hos os får du:

• En fast og varig stilling

• Løn efter kvalifikationer

• En attraktiv pensionsordning og sundhedssikring

• En anderledes og spændende arbejdsplads

• Et stærkt socialt fællesskab og sjove sociale arrangementer

 

Er du klar til at komme med ombord?

Har du lyst til at blive en del af et internationalt team på Skagens største arbejdsplads – så skal du sende din ansøgning afsted nu. Vi behandler ansøgningerne og indkalder til samtaler løbende.

Har du spørgsmål til jobbet, så kan du kontakte Torben Beierholm (Arbejdsleder for Maskin- og Rør / Nybygning) på 26 87 41 21 / tob@kaship.dk

 

Ansøgning sendes til: job@kaship.dk

Tiltrædelse: Snarest muligt

 

Karstensens Skibsværft A/S og KS Elektro A/S beskæftiger i dag 550 medarbejdere og er førende indenfor bygning af pelagiske fiskefartøjer, med en ordrebog på mellem 5-7 nybygninger årligt. Derudover serviceres 100-150 forskellige skibstyper årligt med reparationer og større ombygninger på værftet. 

Mere information findes på værftets hjemmeside: www.karstensens.dk

Are you a trained plumber and ready to try something a bit different – and pretty cool? At Karstensens Shipyard, you’ll have the opportunity to work with plumbing installations on brand-new vessels, where technology, teamwork, and craftsmanship go hand in hand.

Right now, we have 20 vessels on order for delivery over the next two years – and we’re looking for skilled plumbers to strengthen our newbuild department. Our newbuilds are known for their high quality and a strong focus on tailor-made solutions, created through commitment and close collaboration between shipowners and employees.

You’ll work on a variety of tasks and projects across different newbuild vessels – primarily within:

Installation and commissioning of hydronic heating systems

• 

Installation and commissioning of vacuum and toilet systems

• 

Installation and commissioning of cold and hot water systems

We imagine that you:

• 

Are a trained plumber or pipefitter – or have similar qualifications

• 

Want to be part of a dynamic and well-functioning workplace

• 

Are interested in working within the maritime industry

• 

Are reliable, loyal, flexible, and have a positive attitude

We offer:

• 

A permanent and secure position

• 

Salary based on qualifications

• 

Attractive pension scheme and health insurance

• 

A unique and exciting workplace

• 

A strong social environment and fun company events

Ready to come on board?

If you’d like to be part of an international team at Skagen’s largest workplace, send your application today. We’re reviewing applications and conducting interviews on an ongoing basis.

jobs.occupation: Kitchen Manager Røghus - Full-Time · Flyverbyen, Amager
jobs.description:
RØGHUS is looking for an organized and reliable Kitchen Manager to join our growing team in Flyverbyen, Amager.

ABOUT RØGHUS

RØGHUS is a Danish catering and food truck company with a love for food made with smoke and fire.

We are best known for traditional American BBQ and authentic Mexican-inspired food, but most importantly, we believe in making great food from scratch, using quality ingredients and taking pride in the craft behind everything we serve.

For us, RØGHUS is about more than food. It is about hospitality, creating great experiences and treating customers, colleagues and partners with respect. We are an ambitious company, but we also want RØGHUS to be a place where people enjoy coming to work and feel responsible for what we create together.

Currently, our business consists of catering and our food truck, and we are looking for the right person to take responsibility for the day-to-day organization of our kitchen.

ABOUT THE POSITION

As our Kitchen Manager, you will be responsible for keeping the kitchen organized and running smoothly.

• 
Overall organization of the kitchen

• 
Cleaning routines and making sure our hygiene standards are maintained

• 
Staff scheduling

• 
General kitchen maintenance and keeping equipment and work areas in good condition

• 
Purchasing and ordering ingredients, supplies and other necessary goods

• 
Keeping track of stock and helping ensure that we have what we need for upcoming catering jobs and food truck events

• 
Helping create structure and good routines in a growing company

• 
Working closely with the rest of the RØGHUS team

Previous experience from a professional kitchen or a similar position is appreciated, but it is not a requirement.

For us, it is more important that you are organized, reliable and punctual, and that you take responsibility for your work. We are looking for someone who sees what needs to be done and enjoys creating structure around them.

You must be able to speak and write English fluently.

PRACTICAL INFORMATION

Position: Kitchen Manager

Hours: Full-time, 37 hours per week

Location: Flyverbyen, Amager

Salary: Based on qualifications

Application deadline: Monday, October 19, 2026

HOW TO APPLY

Please send your application to christian@roeghus.dk no later than October 19, 2026.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact us at the same email address.

We look forward to hearing from you — and hopefully welcoming you to RØGHUS.

jobs.occupation: Steel Fitters Wanted
jobs.description:
Scan Con Constraction is not a Temp Company (Er ikke et Vikar firma)

We are looking for:

Steel Fitters

Key tasks:

Your job as steel fitter will be responsible for assembling, positioning, aligning, and fitting structural steel components to create frameworks for buildings, bridges, ships, and heavy machinery.

 Your key responsibilities & duties will include:

·         Blueprint Interpretation: Study engineering drawings, blueprints, and material lists to plan the sequence of tasks and determine material requirements.

·         Layout and Fabrication: Layout reference points and patterns on heavy metal to prepare for cutting, bending, and forming.

·         Assembly and Fitting: Assemble, align, and fit metal sections and plates to form complete units or subunits, using tack welding, bolting, or riveting.

·         Machine Operation: Operate heavy-duty machinery such as cranes, shearers, brake presses, grinders, drills, and cutting torches to prepare components.

·         Quality Inspection: Inspect and test completed components to ensure they meet specifications, quality standards, and safety regulations.

·         Positioning and Installation: Position parts in jigs (sometimes created by tack-welding scrap metal) and use grinders, chisels, or files to ensure precise fits.

Skills:

·         English - must be able to communicate in English 

·         Technical Knowledge: Proficient in reading blueprints and technical drawings.

·         Fabrication Skills: Experience (good to have) with metal fabrication techniques, including tack welding, oxy-acetylene cutting, and operating shop machinery.

·         Mathematical Skills: Strong understanding of shop math for measuring, layout, and calculations.

·         Physical Demands: Ability to perform physically demanding work, including standing for long periods, bending, lifting heavy loads, and sometimes working at heights.

jobs.occupation: Lastbilmekanikere Søges
jobs.description:
️ Trailermekanikere søges til førende dansk vognmandsforretning i København

Har du skruet hænderne rigtigt på, og vil du være en del af et stærkt hold hos en af Danmarks største vognmænd?

Vi har rasende travlt og søger lige nu 2-3 dygtige trailermekanikere til vores moderne værksted i København. Uanset om du er i job i dag og trænger til luftforandring, eller om du er klar til at starte med det samme, hører vi meget gerne fra dig!

Hvem er vi?

Vi er en af landets førende vognmandsforretninger med en solid flåde på ca. 750 lastbiler og 1700 trailere. På værkstedet er tempoet højt, humøret godt, og du vil indgå i et stærkt team af dedikerede kollegaer, der løfter i flok for at holde vognparken kørende og trafiksikker.

jobs.occupation: Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Mechanical Engineer to join Biomason’s production facility in Ikast.

This is a hands-on role for someone who is motivated by solving real technical challenges, improving operational and equipment reliability, and helping scale a first-of-a-kind process toward commercial production.

Do you have solid experience from an industrial or manufacturing environment, and do you thrive in a setting where not everything has been fully built or established yet? Then we would very much like to hear from you.

 Read more about the role in the below job description.

If you have technical questions, you are welcome to contact Director of Plant Performance Aaron Bellis at +45 28966291 or HR Partner René Bitsch at +45 21756113.

If you are from a recruitment agency please note that we will contact you if we need your assistance.

Job description

The position:

As Mechanical engineer, you will play a hands-on role in establishing, stabilizing, and improving the mechanical performance of our first-of-a-kind tile production facility in Ikast. This role will work closely together with Operations, Maintenance, Quality, and Process Engineering to ensure safe, reliable, and efficient plant performance. You will help translate innovative process science into robust day-to-day manufacturing at the first of a kind facility, while driving structured problem-solving, equipment reliability, ppm, plant expansion support, and continuous improvement across the facility.

You will support the scaling of this process to our first commercial facility from engineering design and equipment selection through commissioning, start-up, and operations working together with our project department and our EPC firms.

Responsibilities also include:

• 
Mechanical Operations & Equipment Reliability

• 
Provide day-to-day supervisory and execution support for electrical and mechanical systems and production equipment across the tile manufacturing process.

• 
Lead troubleshooting and root cause analysis for mechanical failures, downtime events, and recurring equipment issues.

• 
Help establish preventive and predictive maintenance routines for critical equipment, utilities, and production assets.

• 
Support commissioning, start-up, and scale-up activities in a FOAK environment, helping to translate development work into reliable plant operation.

• 
Production Support & Continuous Improvement

• 
Partner with Operations and Quality teams to improve equipment performance, uptime, process stability, and product consistency.

• 
Contribute to waste reduction, line efficiency, and standardization efforts as production scales.

• 
  Technical leadership

• 
Support the development of SOPs, technical work instructions, equipment care standards, and troubleshooting guides.

• 
Coordinate with vendors, contractors, and internal teams on equipment modifications, installation work, and performance improvements.

• 
Project engineering and commercial facility scale-up

• 
With the Director of projects and an EPC firm, act as Biomason’s lead mechanical engineer supporting the development of FEL3 and detailed engineering design packages including participation in and review of Block Flow Diagrams (BFDs), Heat and Material Balances (HMBs), Piping and Instrumentation Diagrams (P&IDs), General Arrangements (GAs), Basis of Design (BoD) documents, equipment specification and selection, and HAZOP (Hazard an Operations study).

• 
Support the commissioning and startup of the commercial facility through:

• 
Participation in Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) at vendor sites as needed and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT) at the facility.

• 
Provide on-site technical leadership during the "boots-on-the-ground" commissioning phase, troubleshooting mechanical, thermal, or other deviations in real-time.

• 
Bridge the gap between EPC firms and internal operations to ensure a seamless handover.

What we are looking for:

• 
Experience

• 
Minimum 5 years of experience in mechanical engineering, maintenance engineering, or a similar industrial role.

• 
Strong experience in industrial process or manufacturing environments, ideally with automated or semi-automated production equipment. Concrete manufacturing or other heavy industry is bonus but not essential.

• 
Experience with motors, heat exchangers, airflow and hydraulics is a strong advantage.

• 
Basic electrical experience testing logout tag out.

• 
Experience supporting production start-ups, greenfield projects, FOAK environments, or first-time industrial implementation is strongly preferred.

• 
Technical Expertise

• 
Experience working with crane and conveyance systems is a critical requirement of this position

• 
Strong understanding of industrial mechanical systems, equipment reliability, maintenance strategies, and structured troubleshooting.

• 
Experience with 5S, good manufacturing practices, and continuous improvement in a production setting.

• 
Ability to read technical drawings, manuals, equipment layouts, P&IDs, and supplier documentation.

• 
Familiarity with Six Sigma, Lean manufacturing principles, root cause analysis methodologies, and continuous improvement practices is an advantage.

• 
Management & Interpersonal Skills

• 
High attention to detail, with the ability to manage complex, detail-oriented projects and ensure disciplined follow-up through execution.

• 
Strong organizational and communication skills, with the ability to work across functions and cultures, preferable experience from a matrix organization..

• 
Structured, practical, and data-informed approach to problem-solving and decision-making.

• 
Contractor control

• 
Fluency in English is essential

On a personal level, the role needs the following approach:

• 
Proactive with a practical approach and the ability to be hands-on 

• 
Motivation to solve real industrial challenges

• 
Flexible where systems and routines are still being built

• 
A collaborative mindset, but also the ability to solve matters on your own

• 
Good safety attitude

• 
Can do attitude

The clinic is open five to seven days a week throughout the year. Many of our patients come from abroad, although we also treat a considerable number of Danish patients. We offer a full range of treatments within IUI, IVF/ICSI, egg donation and ROPA.

We are a straightforward and informal workplace guided by the principle of freedom with responsibility. jobs.occupation: Chief Commercial Officer
jobs.description:
About Memtrace

AI coding agents are fast, but they forget. They lose context between sessions, repeat mistakes, and don't understand the codebase around them. Memtrace builds the memory layer that fixes this: a deterministic knowledge graph of your code, built with AST parsing rather than guesswork, that any coding agent can use. Our products include MemDB, MemFleet, Cortex, and a code review engine. We are backed by Antler and Innovation Fund Denmark, and we work with Google, AWS, and Microsoft for Startups.

The role

You will own revenue end to end: strategy, pipeline, pricing, partnerships, and the first commercial team. We have developer interest and active pilots with enterprise customers. Your job is to turn that into repeatable, paying adoption. At this stage you will do the selling yourself while building the playbook that others will follow.

What you will do

• 
Define and run the go-to-market motion: developers adopt, engineering leaders and budget-holders buy.

• 
Own the revenue number and the pipeline. Run discovery, demos, pilots, and negotiations personally.

• 
Convert pilots into contracts, with clear success criteria, pricing, and procurement paths.

• 
Set pricing and packaging for individual, team, and enterprise tiers.

• 
Build channel and ecosystem partnerships (cloud marketplaces, consultancies, industry bodies, AI-coding-tool vendors).

• 
Feed customer and market insight back to product and research, and help decide what we build next.

• 
Hire and lead the first commercial team (sales, solutions, customer success) when the time is right.

• 
Report on pipeline, conversion, and retention to the founders and investors.

What we are looking for

• 
8+ years in B2B software sales or commercial leadership, with at least one role in developer tools, data/AI infrastructure, or open-source-led products.

• 
A track record of closing enterprise deals yourself, ideally in the Nordics or wider Europe.

• 
Experience selling to both technical champions and executive buyers, and knowing how those conversations differ.

• 
Comfort with ambiguity: you have built a sales motion without an existing playbook, brand, or team.

• 
Enough technical depth to talk credibly with engineers about codebases, CI/CD, and AI agents.

• 
Strong written and spoken English; Danish or another Nordic language is a plus.

Nice to have

• 
Experience with PLG, usage-based pricing, or open-core models.

• 
Existing relationships with engineering leaders at Nordic enterprises.

• 
Experience with EU procurement, security reviews, and data-residency requirements.

What we offer

• 
A founding-team seat with real ownership of the commercial side of the company.

• 
Direct influence on product, positioning, and company direction.

• 
Hybrid work in Copenhagen, with a small and fast-moving team.
